note: INEGI terrain web layers for /labs prototypes (terrain agent). Web Mercator XYZ tiles, 256 px. Tiles exist only where they touch the 5 m grid (AOI envelope); outside, leave them absent and fall back to AWS Terrarium. Use exaggeration 1 when displaying elevation values.
attribution: Relieve © INEGI (Modelos Digitales de Elevación 5 m, MDT/MDS)

layers.label: Relieve (MDT INEGI 5 m, terreno desnudo)
layers.editions: INEGI MDT 5 m editions 2016, 2017, 2018, 2022, 2024 (152 sheets, satellite stereo photogrammetry; imagery 2014-2022)
layers.verticalDatum: Orthometric metres; NAVD88 (2016-2018 eds) and GGM10 (2022-2024 eds) sheets harmonized by per-sheet constant offsets (GGM10 sheets +0.40 m mean). Effectively the NAVD88-based majority.
layers.encodingNotes: Same as AWS Terrarium: elevation = R*256 + G + B/256 - 32768, quantized to 1/64 m. Drop-in for MapLibre raster-dem (encoding 'terrarium').
layers.coverage: 87.7% of the grid is INEGI; NW/NE corners north of ~20.87-20.92 N and a SW corner block are AWS Terrarium shifted onto INEGI (all outside the urban bbox). Pixels outside the grid envelope in edge tiles are AWS Terrarium.
layers.notes: Bare earth: buildings and trees removed by INEGI; bridges/overpasses removed. Shows faceted TIN artefacts in flat urban areas at z15.

layers.label: Sombreado del relieve (MDT INEGI 5 m)
layers.encoding: 8-bit greyscale PNG (opaque); azimuth 315, altitude 45, true metres (no vertical exaggeration). Use raster-opacity ~0.3-0.5 over a basemap.

layers.label: Altura sobre el terreno (MDS−MDT INEGI, incluye árboles)
layers.encoding: Palette RGBA PNG; transparent where DSM-DTM < 1 m or not INEGI. Colour ramp (m, colour, alpha): 1 #fde9a8 .16, 3 #f8b14a .39, 6 #f08228 .63, 10 #e8590c .78, 25 #b0174f .90, 60+ #5c0a6b .96, linear between stops. Empty tiles are written as fully transparent PNGs (no 404s inside the tile set).
layers.editions: INEGI MDS + MDT 5 m, same sheets/editions as the DTM
layers.notes: Includes trees, bridges and photogrammetric noise; not measured building heights. Lower zooms show 2x2-averaged heights.
